upload.itMessage:
Hello IT team,

For the Sanford ERP migration of {{company}} ({{name}}), please run the attached 05_hana_export.sql on the HANA schema {{schema}}:

1. Query 1 → save as columns.csv (column order; the data files have no header)
2. Query 2 → save as constraints.csv (real table keys)
3. Query 4 → save as row_counts.csv (rows per table)
4. Query 9 (EXPORT "{{schema}}"."*" AS CSV) → the data export folder

Please use CSV, not Excel (Excel changes some table names, e.g. AUG1 becomes a date). Zip the export folder together with the three CSV files and upload it in Super ERP › Back Office › Upload backup, or send me the link.

Thank you

run.title: Rebuild run
run.note: Runs on the migration server, not in this browser · you can close this page and come back
run.notFound: Run not found or you can't see it.
run.stepsCaption: each step must pass before the next starts
run.safe1: Only {{code}} rows are replaced. The other companies keep working; their SAP updates wait until this run ends.
run.safe2: If a step fails or you stop the run, {{code}} goes back to exactly the data it had before, and the reason goes to the issue list. Stop takes effect before the next step.
run.stopBody: The migration server stops before its next step and puts {{code}} back exactly as it was before the run.
run.stopNotRunning: Only a run that is uploading, queued or running can be stopped
run.reviewBanner: The rebuild finished. Check the totals and sign off.
run.failedBanner: The run failed at “{{step}}”. {{code}} is unchanged.
run.cancelledBanner: The run was stopped. {{code}} is exactly as it was before.

gl.title: G/L Account Determination
gl.desc: Which account each kind of posting uses. Documents made in Super ERP post with these accounts; a missing one stops the posting and says so.
gl.cleared: Cleared: {{label}}. Postings that need it will be refused until it is set.
gl.missing_one: {{count}} posting key is not set for {{company}}. Documents that need it can't post until Finance sets it.
gl.missing_other: {{count}} posting keys are not set for {{company}}. Documents that need them can't post until Finance sets them.
gl.note: Every change is recorded in the audit log. Accounts from SAP stay read-only during the soft switch.

per.title: Posting Periods
per.desc: Months open for posting. Journals and Super ERP documents dated in a closed or locked period are refused.
per.emptyBody: Add a year to create its 12 monthly periods. Until then nothing can be posted for this company.

means.open: Anyone with full Financials can post on these dates.
means.closed: Nothing can be posted. Finance can reopen it, for example to post a late correction.
means.locked: Nothing can be posted. Use it for months that are final, such as after the year-end audit.

per.lockBody: Nothing can be posted on these dates while the period is locked. Every change is logged.
